turnos.t: Why does change so often cause conflict?
Because it creates winners and losers. Automation, relocation, closures and mergers change who gets what. Shareholders may gain from lower costs while employees lose jobs and suppliers lose orders.

In May 2020, Nissan announced it would close its Barcelona plants. Workers went on strike, and production stopped for about four months. In August, a deal delayed the closure to December 2021: a negotiated compromise.
